svg.text: Crashes, segfaults, logic bugs, wrong values
Breakpoints, watchpoints, stack traces, memory inspection
Uninit value use, double free, overlapping memcpy
No recompilation needed | Helgrind: data races
Requires recompilation | Cannot combine with TSan
Signed integer overflow, shift overflow, div-by-zero
Combine with ASan for maximum coverage
CPU hotspots, cache misses, branch mispredictions
Code quality, bug-prone patterns, cert compliance
NULL deref, sizeof misuse, unchecked return values
Static — no runtime needed | Can auto-fix issues (-fix)
Warnings → clang-tidy → ASan+UBSan → Valgrind → GDB (on crash) → perf (on slowness)
